source.title: Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning
source.version: Review of Financial Studies 33(5), author-hosted PDF

claims.statement: Elastic net combines absolute-value and squared-coefficient penalties.
claims.implementation: CrossSectionalRank.train: soft-threshold coordinate update with fixed L1/L2 shares

claims.statement: Forecast-sorted portfolios take long high-prediction stocks and short low-prediction stocks.
claims.implementation: CrossSectionalRank.decide: rank complete daily cross-section and target high/low symbols

chosen_variant: Two-characteristic elastic net and top-one/bottom-one rank on three symbols
adaptations: The source uses a large equity universe, many firm characteristics, monthly returns, validation-selected hyperparameters and multiple model families; this sample fixes two synthetic characteristics, three symbols, daily returns and one declared penalty.

The implementation uses coordinate descent for the same elastic-net objective instead of the paper's accelerated proximal gradient solver. It does not implement Huber loss or report paper performance.
The reference engine emits paired target positions after all three daily closes and fills each symbol separately at its next opening; it does not guarantee atomic portfolio rebalancing.
